node: Automotive aluminum sheet and specialty rolling capacity
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe around automotive aluminum rolling after the Novelis Oswego outage highlighted concentration risk in qualified U.S. auto-body sheet supply. The cleanest direct public exposure is Constellium as an established automotive body sheet and EV battery-enclosure supplier. Kaiser Aluminum and Ryerson are underfollowed U.S.-listed smaller-cap adjacent plays with plausible specialty sheet, coil, processing, and distribution relevance, but their direct ability to absorb auto-body-sheet emergency demand needs verification. Steel Dynamics is a reference/new-capacity name because its Aluminum Dynamics flat-rolled mill is ramping and targets automotive mix, but its company-level market cap is above the preferred hunting range.
